title: Enhanced performance of PEMFC through novel flow field design and optimization
journal: International Journal of Heat and Mass Transfer 255 (2026) 127792
scope: Steady coupled 3D PEM fuel cell and four-factor net-power optimization; not an electrolyzer or transient bubble-resolved VOF model.

assumptions: Full symmetric cell, uniform isotropic porous layers, no gravity, laminar flow.
BP thickness interpreted as 0.5 mm backing plus 1 mm channel region.
Reconstructed Table 2/Fig. 2 profiles; exact CAD and port details are not supplied.
ESCFF has 15 rows at 1.5 mm pitch, four mirrored paths, inferred central 1x1 mm through-backing inlet and two perimeter outlets.
Serpentine reconstruction has 11 passes; CDLIS has two mirrored 20-pass channels and a 1 mm central divider. Those comparison dimensions are estimates.
Orthogonal voxel meshes approximate inclined walls; sharp-wall geometry and mesh sensitivity must be assessed before ranking close designs.

physics.channels: Steady laminar Navier-Stokes with pressure projection
physics.porous_gas: Darcy velocity with epsilon^2 resistance and (1-s)^3 gas relative permeability
physics.species: Conservative molar mixture transport; O2/H2 and vapor with N2 complement on cathode and H2/H2O binary closure on anode
physics.liquid: Hydrophobic Darcy/capillary transport in CL/GDL; carrier advection plus dispersion in channels
physics.charge: Coupled electronic/protonic charge conservation with signed Butler-Volmer sources
physics.membrane: Water diffusion, electro-osmotic drag and gas/membrane sorption
physics.thermal: Solid/fluid conduction, sensible enthalpy, kinetic/Joule heating, evaporation/condensation latent heat

discrepancies: Table 3 says concentration exponent 1; printed Eqs. 9/10 use 3. Default follows the equations; exponent 1 is configurable.
Printed source signs/mass units and liquid-water notation are inconsistent. Implementation uses conservative signed-current/Faraday conventions.
The article does not supply a complete numerical parameter set or CAD; no exact quantitative replication is claimed.
Reference current Iref is not reported: 15000 A/m2 is a declared estimate used in Eq. 16/17, not fitted to a desired net power.

External BP surfaces are isothermal with conjugate internal conduction. For temperature optimization wall/feed temperature follows the operating-temperature design variable; literal constant 333.15 K internal channel walls would be a different thermal boundary interpretation.
Diffusion is expressed using mixture molar fractions at local ideal-gas concentration; cross-diffusion and Soret terms are not included.
Channel phase change and water dispersion, membrane sorption, capillary closure and kinetic constants are explicit supplementary closures.
No hidden tuning to published power, no surrogate fallback for failed CFD.

supplementary_framework.reference: Springer, Zawodzinski and Gottesfeld (1991), Polymer Electrolyte Fuel Cell Model, DOI 10.1149/1.2085971
supplementary_framework.note: Springer-type membrane hydration/conductivity/drag; individual effective constants remain declared estimates.

optimization.design: 27-row Box-Behnken, 25 unique points; quadratic coded response surface
optimization.method: Enumerate all box faces of the quadratic; verify the selected candidate with a fresh coupled CFD case.
optimization.qualification_gate: Baseline first; then every DOE case must qualify. Generic optimizers also require a qualified baseline.

numerics.qualification: Five consecutive final-voltage qualified iterations plus independent saved-field/source/constitutive checks. False-transient liquid storage is excluded from physical conservation checks.
not_established: agreement with the published CFD fields or experimental polarization curves
